translations.web: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.
translations.bsb: In the same way, the women must be dignified, not slanderers, but temperate and faithful in all things.
translations.kjv: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
translations.asv: Women in like manner must be grave, not slanderers, temperate, faithful in all things.
